design: At attention5 final-token write subtract a*n times each locked factorial component: total, transported value, routing, cross, source roles and all9 heads. Native bus unchanged; downstream computation recomputed. Each component has paired norm-matched random factorial edits, plus a common identity arm.
source_roles: Period is suffix:0 (verified punctuation token in manifest); other suffix includes remaining trailing tokens. Role/head terms are summed native P*V interactions, hence independent of missing-slot value-padding convention. Value/routing/cross inherit H970 padding convention.
metrics: Native-aligned answer-margin loss, KL(native||edited); KL(full-interaction-removal||component-removal) normalized by KL(full-removal||native) to assess whether component removal reproduces the full intervention.
scope: Same24 locked quartets; only familiar formatA passes native gate. Exploratory same-panel decomposition, no new generalization claim. These are output component removals, not direct routing or value modifications inside attention.
